title: Training Notes: Refrigerant Pounds Paid on Harbison Parts-and-Labor Protection Claims
content:
These notes cover the refrigerant pounds paid on a refrigerant-circuit claim against a Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection, Harbison 12-Year Total Protection or Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus contract of Harbison Protection Contracts.

**Which earlier refrigerant is looked at?**
The refrigerant the holder's Harbison invoices show added in the twelve calendar months before the date of handling — the refrigerant lines on the holder's service calls under Repair and Emergency Service Calls — with the claim's own service call not counted. These are the "earlier pounds".

**How many pounds are paid?**

| Earlier pounds | Pounds paid on the claim |
|---|---|
| 3.0 lb or more (the pre-existing-leak pounds) | none |
| above zero and below 3.0 lb | the pounds billed on the claim's service call less the earlier pounds, never below zero, up to the tier's refrigerant pound limit |
| none | the pounds billed on the claim's service call, up to the tier's refrigerant pound limit |

**Where is the line drawn?** Exactly 3.0 earlier pounds reach the pre-existing-leak pounds, and no refrigerant is paid; 2.9 lb is below them.

**Worked cases (hypothetical; refrigerant pound limit of 6 lb is illustrative).**

| Pounds billed on the claim's call | Earlier pounds | Pounds paid |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | none | 5 |
| 5 | 2 | 3 |
| 5 | 3 | 0 |
| 2 | 2.5 | 0 (never below zero) |
| 9 | 1 | 6 (8, up to the 6 lb limit) |
| 9 | none | 6 (up to the limit) |

**Is refrigerant on the claim's own call counted as earlier?**
No. The pounds billed on the claim's own service call are excluded from the earlier pounds, even when that call falls within the twelve months.
